groups.id: battle coordinate admission and overflow predicates have deliberate policies
groups.comparison: 880 whole95 private finite f32, signed coordinates including negative and default0, checked Serde via TryFrom. checked_add rejects nonfinite output; elapsed_since rejects negative/unrepresentable span, saturating variant intentionally maps negative overflow to0 but rejects positive overflow. is_within subtracts then compares finite tolerance; overflow correctly cannot be within a finite tolerance. precedes_with_margin overflowing positive sum correctly cannot precede another finite coordinate. These are predicates, not retained invalid coordinate mutation. Does not prove adding every positive tiny elapsed changes a large coordinate or define strict progress for all native precision; actual schedule operations need their own progress contract.

groups.id: book band and target family validity belong to one canonical policy
groups.comparison: 885 whole529 with every inline fixture. rank_band derives (quality−1,quality) saturating, while book_shape_is_valid requires quality1..actual family cap and valid terrain string. Ordinary skill targets share closed supported names with their caps; raw Book/BookTarget schema remains broader, so call to rank_band alone is not semantic admission. Current normal catalogue gate and DB study caller are separate exact dependencies. No upper1 rule imposed on SignedPrecision or unrelated values.

groups.id: generic bounded training commits one accepted gain and residual time
groups.comparison: 885 apply_bounded rejects nonfinite/nonpositive real time and nonfinite rank/aptitude/medium, enforces readable medium and lower/upper eligibility. It projects current direct and candidate effective hours, then binary searches64 to avoid crossing effective ceiling, mutating only after accepted_direct is chosen. This requires supplied hours curve/effective projection be the actual monotone finite direct-hours contract; arbitrary Fn values are not certified. Reports accepted direct-effective gain plus leftover real time with the same reading rate, which is distinct from aptitude training multiplier. Raw public BoundedBookGain can be independently fabricated, not a validity token. Generic infinity ceiling/callback behavior and raw direct hours remain capacity qualifications; no ordinary bad book or training overflow claimed from hypothetical callbacks.

groups.id: written training uses one baseline for changing correlated literacy
groups.comparison: 885 specialized written branch copies baseline hours, projects only target direct column on that baseline, derives medium correlation/base from the same fixed language family. It analytically integrates the changing medium literacy until saturation, caps desired target-effective hours with the same projection and searches64 if needed, then computes real time consumed through the inverse using same accepted endpoint. Medium rank>=1 and actual readable baseline are necessary positive-divisor conditions, not independent language-name guarantees. Finite intelligence/clamped5 gives bounded5000 ceiling on normal valid language hours; lower raw family arithmetic/Serde gaps remain separate RootF016 source contracts, not closed by this wrapper.

groups.id: candidate identity and fixtures retain exact limits
groups.comparison: 885 filters usefulness, sorts personal first then lower quality then item ID, dedups adjacent equal IDs and takes first. Ordinary duplicates of the same immutable catalogue book have same quality/personal key grouping; raw BookCandidate can bind unrelated book to item ID, and heterogeneous duplicate IDs need an actual supplier identity contract rather than a guessed universal dedup proof. It returns only one candidate, so nonadjacent inconsistent duplicates do not create a multi-book allocation here. Original315–529 fixtures compare clipping/residual time, personal ordering, correlated bulk/chunk behavior, zero-direct gate and family caps, source only/no execution or new cases.

remaining_dependency_obligations: Actual normal catalogue book semantics, canonical hours curves/correlations and DB candidate bindings remain precise separately queued suppliers; no generic callback proof from name.
